Rule: A hire cannot be created without an approved position or approved exception.
A position must be linked to a valid cost centre and organisation unit.
An employee has one active primary assignment at a time unless a concurrent employment rule applies.
Right to work must be verified before the start date; exceptions need approval.
Changes to pay need a second approver above a set threshold.
Benefit eligibility follows country plan rules and employment type.
A change effective in the past needs payroll review before approval.
Restricted fields are visible only to roles with a recorded need.
Leaver access is removed on the last working day.
Records are deleted or anonymised at the retention date unless a legal hold applies.
Contingent workers must have a sponsor and an end date.
Duplicate person records are merged under data steward control.
Works-council agreements can disable a data field or report in a country.
Any AI-generated change proposal needs human approval before it is saved.
